main_measure.name: mean of forecast/10 x coin's excess 10-bar return, non-overlapping grid

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases of one day summed as one piece of evidence

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with day-clustered t >= 2 and supporting check passes; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: Welch difference of directional excess return, top third minus bottom third by |forecast| (Welch t 0.583)

decided_by: The t lies between -2 and 2, which the plan calls inconclusive.
reading: Cases are the grid bars (positions 0, 10, 20, ... of each window, with t+10 inside the window) with a nonzero forecast, the coin's mean 10-bar return is taken over all grid bars of all its windows, the thirds are the n//3 cases with the smallest and largest |forecast| by stable rank, and the day-clustered t sums the cases' deviations per UTC day.
